message: Operation 'public_v1_list_products' has semantic quality issues: vague_summary, missing_context. Original summary 'List products' is too generic. The description, while comprehensive, is dense and difficult for AI agents to parse. Improved summary emphasizes pagination and filtering capabilities. Reorganized description into clearer sections: pagination mechanism, bulk lookup, incremental sync pattern, available filters, and scope requirement. This helps AI agents understand when to use this operation and how to construct requests.

data.current_description:
The project's products, keyset-paged by id (``limit`` ≤ 200).

Bulk lookup: ``ids`` or ``skus`` (comma-separated, up to 200 each).
Incremental sync: ``updated_since`` (ISO-8601) returns products modified
at or after that instant — page until ``has_more`` is false, then store
the highest ``updated_at`` you saw. Further filters: ``category_id``
(direct membership), ``status``, ``product_type``, ``parent_id``
(variants of a configurable product). Requires ``products:read``.
data.summary_suggestion: List and filter project products with pagination
data.description_suggestion: Retrieve paginated products from the project with keyset pagination by ID (limit ≤ 200). Supports bulk lookup by product IDs or SKUs (comma-separated, up to 200 each), incremental sync via ``updated_since`` (ISO-8601 timestamp), and filtering by category (direct membership), status, product type, and parent product ID (for variants). Use ``has_more`` to determine if additional pages exist; store the highest ``updated_at`` for subsequent incremental syncs. Requires ``products:read`` scope.
